minimum_charge_rule_basis: Manual section 4.3.5 step 5 read literally: if, after all credits, the parcel's monthly total SWMS charge is less than the non-residential minimum, each account is subject to the minimum; otherwise each account pays its allocated share, even below the minimum. Tariff 2026-09-01 sections 4.3(a)(6), 4.3(a)(8), 4.5(b). PWD's published charges follow this reading on all 7 multi-account parcels of the 2026-11-16 snapshot (2,590 parcels) where it differs from a per-account minimum; accounts with a 0% allocation are billed nothing (60 of 60). See docs/RULES.md.
unsupported_combinations: Overlapping benefit ledger IDs without resolved sequencing
Aggregate existing credits with corrections or new benefits before spatial reconciliation
Recorded NPDES credit together with recorded aggregate GA/IA credits (whether they include the 7% NPDES area credit is unknown)
Scenarios that reconcile existing credits or compute the NPDES residual while the recorded IAR split is unknown
fractional_curve_number_policy: Whole CN steps below 75 (manual 4.3.3.1: a percent reduction for each whole number below a CN of 75), i.e. steps = floor(75 - average CN); average summed in Decimal from area x CN (Appendix A steps 3-5)
money_rounding_policy: PWD binary floating point: each GA/IA charge, the parcel SWMS, each allocated account share and each account total rounded as round_half_even(double x 100) / 100 (.NET Math.Round default); reproduces all 2,325 computable nonresidential/condominium totals of the 2026-11-16 snapshot. Parcel-level minimum after credits.
source_download_status: Current manual and tariff original PDF bytes captured locally with SHA-256 after initial restricted DNS failure.
npdes_max_compliance_lag_basis: Project screening threshold, not a PWD or DEP rule: manual 4.3.4 requires compliance during the preceding twelve months and 4.5.5 the DMRs from the previous 12 months; a lagging DMR period is accepted only when no DMR has fallen due since it ended (next_dmr_due after the assessment date) and it ended within this many months.
npdes_residual_rule: Manual 4.3.5.2 read literally: remaining uncredited IA (IA after IAR minus IA Managed) x 7% toward both IA and GA; 7% of all IA and GA only when no other GA or IA credit applies. A drop below the NPDES-alone credit is reported as a manual rule discontinuity. NPDES is applied as area credits only (no charge-percentage discount).
green_roof_rule: Manual Table 1 and 4.3.2.1: rooftop disconnection via green roof is an impervious area reduction (IAR) equal to the green-roof footprint on mapped IA; manual 4.5.1 requires a site plan and recent photographs.
